title: 72yo M Toxicology
background: Patient was found unresponsive at home with an empty pill bottle nearby. He has a history of atrial fibrillation and hypertension. The bottle on the kitchen table is his digoxin, dispensed eight days ago.

exam.finding: Clear breath sounds, slow regular respirations

investigations.name: 12-Lead ECG
investigations.report: Atrial fibrillation with a slow ventricular response at 35/min, scooped (reverse tick) ST depression and frequent ventricular ectopics. Typical of digoxin toxicity.

investigations.name: Serum digoxin
investigations.report: Toxic. A level taken after Fab is given is unreliable, so this one matters.

data.label: Call family for history (Empathy)
data.narrative: The family appreciates the call and provides a detailed medical history. Your reputation increases.

distractors.label: Give IV calcium gluconate for the potassium of 6.2
distractors.feedback: Hyperkalaemia here is a marker of digoxin poisoning, not the primary problem. Calcium is traditionally avoided in digoxin toxicity, and the bradycardia with hypotension needs treating first.

distractors.label: Give IV metoprolol to control the atrial fibrillation
distractors.feedback: He is bradycardic at 35 with a systolic of 80. A beta blocker would deepen the block and the shock.

data.label: Temporising only
data.narrative: Heart rate rises to 45 with atropine, but that is a holding measure. The digoxin is still bound to the sodium pumps in his heart.

doseMap.Digoxin immune Fab IV: Life-threatening toxicity with an unknown dose: 10 vials IV over 30 minutes, repeat if no response. Potassium falls as the Fab works, so watch for hypokalaemia.

distractors.label: Haemodialysis to remove the digoxin
distractors.feedback: Digoxin has a huge volume of distribution and is barely removed by dialysis. Fab fragments are the antidote.

distractors.label: Wait for a repeat digoxin level before the antidote
distractors.feedback: Bradycardia with shock and a potassium above 5 is life-threatening toxicity. Give Fab now.

data.label: Rhythm restored
data.narrative: Within 40 minutes his rate is 72 and his pressure 118/70. Potassium falls to 4.4 without any other treatment. He wakes and asks why everyone is standing round his bed.
